name: Neuronic Core Library

dispatch_notes.coder: Core services (auth, API, token management), data models, utilities
dispatch_notes.coder-frontend: Reusable widgets, theme system, design tokens
dispatch_notes.security-auditor: Cognito auth flows, JWT token management, API service security
dispatch_notes.dependency-manager: Pub.dev dependencies, version alignment with consuming apps
dispatch_notes.reviewer: API surface review, breaking change detection

guidance.stack_summary: Dart 3.x / Flutter / neuronic_core package / AWS Cognito + Pinpoint / GetX / JWT / GetStorage
structure: lib/services/ — Core services (auth, API, token management)
lib/network/ — Network layer (API constants, response models)
lib/theme/ — UI theme (colors, text styles, app theme, assets)
lib/widgets/ — Reusable UI components (buttons, inputs, protocols)
ci_cd: No automated publish — manual version bumps

custom_rules: Consumed as git dependency by clinical-main and potentially light-app
Changes here can break downstream apps — coordinate version bumps
No CLAUDE.md in this repo — follows Neuronic global conventions
